vmCorrespondenceScope: Trace-level bytecode execution of the 31 pinned getter regions plus the shared private callees GetAccountState, GetPendingModuleCallRecord and GetMarketEscrowOwnerCancelInitiated: each stated conditional behavior class agrees with the source-level outcome in the kernel (3 keyed storage getters (miss + hit-valid/hit-invalid-width for hash160, miss + hit-integer for integer decode); 4 fixed-prefix getters with no ABI argument, the key being the pinned prefix itself (miss + hit-valid/hit-invalid-width); 2 fixed-prefix timelock getters with no ABI argument (miss + hit-offset, the decoded timestamp plus the pinned delay constant); 1 raw payload getters (miss + hit, the stored payload returned verbatim with the pinned empty default); 2 inline epoch getters building their own key and deserializing in place: a miss returns the pinned integer default through the early-return guard, a hit projects one PendingConfigUpdate field and adds the pinned timelock (miss-early-return + hit-projection-offset); 3 presence getters (miss + hit); 2 delegating presence getters reading through the shared GetPendingModuleCallRecord callee (miss + hit); 6 delegating record projections reading one PendingModuleCall field through the same shared callee (miss + hit-projection; the Time pair additionally adds the pinned timelock, the Hash pair returns the stored CallHash under the pinned zero-length default); 1 the delegating raw epoch getter (getMarketEscrowOwnerCancelTime), which casts the shared reader's raw payload with the pinned decode and adds the pinned timelock (miss + hit-offset); 1 the delegating raw presence getter (hasMarketEscrowOwnerCancel), which tests the shared reader's raw result against null (miss + hit); 5 shared GetAccountState field projections (miss-abort + hit-projection); 1 the escape predicate (miss-abort + hit-projection-compare)); successful epoch sums require signed 256-bit representability. Programs, slot targets, call/return frames, callee parameter bindings, syscall pop order and cast widths are rendered from the decoded region bytes; StdLib.Deserialize is a pinned token index whose behavior is a universally quantified oracle, and the escrow owner-cancel accessors (which read their payload verbatim through the shared raw reader and perform no deserialize of their own) consume no token. 4 semantic and 14 bytecode mutation controls, each bytecode control compiled with an accepted unmutated twin, are rejected by the kernel.

tcb: Strict typed-source grammar over the exported Roslyn operation trees.
Pinned framework callee symbols (Helper.Concat, Storage.Get, ExecutionEngine.Assert, StdLib.Deserialize) and the reviewed UInt160.Zero / Int32-literal / zero-length-byte-string defaults.
Abstract storage map: single-key lookup with no aliasing, iteration or read-size semantics; each prefix is resolved from its own declaration in the inputs.

VM model in StorageGetterVm: one instruction per slot, the decoded interop pop order for System.Storage.Get (context handle then key), structural equality including null, and little-endian integer decode; slot/target correspondence is pinned by the runner from the decoded region bytes.

Call/return frames share one evaluation stack and the local/argument slots; the certified regions have disjoint local usage (the callers declare no locals and never read an argument after the certified CALL), pinned by the runner. A callee declaring more than one parameter takes its arguments from the operand block the caller pushes immediately before the certified CALL, whose shape the runner checks and whose values it places in the traced argument vector.

AccountState, PendingModuleCall and PendingConfigUpdate field ordinals are derived from the class declaration order in the inputs and cross-checked against the bytecode PICKITEM index rendered from the pinned regions.

The shared escrow owner-cancel reader is delegated through the debug-only method table and returns the stored payload verbatim (or the null item), performing no deserialize: its callers apply the pinned null test and the little-endian cast plus pinned timelock themselves. Its pinned prefix is resolved from its own declaration in the inputs.
